xmldoc.short_description: Read records from proto3 JSON or NDJSON.

syntax.syntax_item: [value, presence, report] = protobuf.fromjson(schema, type, txt, name, value, ...)
[value, presence, report] = protobuf.fromjson(schema, type, txt, 'NDJSON', true, name, value, ...)

param_input_item.param_description: a schema from protobuf.load and a message type.
a character vector: a proto3 JSON object, or an array of objects.
logical (default false): read one JSON object per line (blank lines skipped, errors name the line).

description.p: protobuf.fromjson reads proto3 JSON back into Nelson values, like protobuf.decode and with the same layout options. It accepts both the JSON field names and the .proto field names. With 'NDJSON', it reads one object per line.
